description: A *-digest.md no manifest pack produces. In CHECK mode this fails: an orphan digest is a page of law-shaped text that nothing regenerates, so it drifts from the moment it is written and no check would ever say so. Contrast DIGEST-018, where generate mode reports the same file as a NOTE — the author is mid-edit, not wrong.

Non-authoritative: for orientation only. The source documents prevail (constitution
II is unchanged); read the full document before acting on its area. -->
